FAQs

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Good questions. Clear answers.

Explore the planned scope and discuss any remaining questions with us.

Free core & servicesWorkflow & reportsSetup & languageExtensions

Free core & services

Is the core software free? +

Yes. The core software is offered free for one diagnostic center with one active branch. Its described features are planned; confirm current availability with us.

Free core ↗
Are hosting and setup also free? +

The software is free. Offline setup and documentation cost ৳4,999 once. Cloud setup is free, with a ৳299 monthly server charge. Other support and custom work are discussed separately.

Free core ↗
Does the free core include multiple branches? +

The free core is scoped for one active branch. Multi-branch is a planned paid extension with availability and terms to be confirmed.

Extensions ↗

Workflow & reports

Can we record bKash and card payments? +

Cash, bKash, and card payments can be recorded manually in the planned core. An online gateway is a separate planned extension.

Billing & accounts ↗
Can we create imaging reports? +

Narrative templates are planned for X-ray, ultrasound, ECG, and other special tests, with an optional image or PDF attachment. PACS and DICOM are outside scope.

Pathology & reports ↗
Who verifies results? +

An authorized staff member other than the person who entered the result verifies it before release.

Pathology & reports ↗
What happens if a released report needs correction? +

A correction requires a reason and fresh verification. Earlier released versions remain traceable and amended reports are marked.

Pathology & reports ↗
Does this include pharmacy and appointments? +

The diagnostic core focuses on testing and billing. Pharmacy, appointments, inpatient care, and PACS are outside v1.

Features ↗

Setup & language

Can our team use Bangla? +

The software is designed with Bangla and English interfaces and support for Bangla text in patient information and reports.

Features ↗
Which printer or barcode labels do we need? +

Printer compatibility and label size depend on the final setup. Tell us what equipment you use so we can discuss your needs.

Getting started ↗
Can we move existing records? +

Migration depends on the format and quality of existing data. Discuss your records, balances, and requirements before setup.

Getting started ↗
How do we request a demo? +

Call, message on WhatsApp, or prepare an email from the contact page. We can discuss a walkthrough; the request does not itself book an appointment.

Contact ↗

Extensions

Are extensions available now? +

The extensions listed on the site are planned or later possibilities. Their availability, prices, and terms have not been confirmed.
